rules.rule: Canonical candidate source must remain the exact 92283-Point source and exact rows 30762/46142/61522; nearest fallback forbidden.
HMLR support seed is accepted only for exact INSPIRE ID, native EPSG:27700 geometry, unique match, point_inside=true and retained ZIP/GML/feature hashes.
Row 61522 authority is Lambeth; prior support-only Merton route is superseded and forbidden.
Successful GitHub Actions package validation cannot be promoted to canonical runner execution or official numeric output.
Actions artifact digest must match the queue-recorded SHA256 before its receipt is trusted.
F-host execution requires real receipts 015/016/014/003 plus daemon_count=1, fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim.
EA DTM1m sampling must auto-discover a real CoverageId from WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities or verify a configured ID is present.
EA DescribeCoverage axis labels and actual GetCoverage GeoTIFF bytes are required; endpoint reachability alone is not a sample.
EA raster must resolve to EPSG:27700; only valid pixel centres inside exact HMLR polygon are sampled.
EA NoData values including documented -3.4028235e+38 class values are excluded; empty valid pixels fail closed.
EA output must retain CoverageId, GetCapabilities/DescribeCoverage hashes, GetCoverage URL, GeoTIFF SHA256, Q1/median/Q3/min/max and pixel count.
OS Terrain50 must be current July 2026 OpenData and actual API-selected ZIP bytes must be obtained before crosscheck.
OS selected archives must contain ASCII grid members and pass safe ZIP path/size validation.
Prepared Terrain50 cells are TQ39 col112 row13, TQ59 col40 row190, TQ27 col190 row198 under the official 200x200 north-first 50m contract.
OS value is secondary only; EA DTM1m polygon median remains primary numeric source.
No numeric row is accepted unless EA status THREE_EA_DTM1M_POLYGON_SAMPLES_READY and OS status THREE_OS_TERRAIN50_CROSSCHECKS_READY are both real output files.
Official gate status must be THREE_OFFICIAL_NUMERIC_ROWS_READY_PENDING_REVIEW; automatic final promotion remains forbidden.
Transport failure, unsupported XML parsing or DNS failure is not NO_DATA and must not create a fabricated measurement.
